run_verify_dataset_parallel: run the verify_dataset_parallel function to verify a Habitat dataset with parallel episode processing
run_verify_dataset_cli: run the CLI script to verify dataset episodes load and eval measures don't crash
run_summarize_verifications: run summarize_verifications to aggregate and display metrics from episode verification result files
run_assert_eval_handles_exist: run assert_eval_handles_exist to verify all evaluation object handles exist in the Habitat simulator
run_assert_constraint_args_exist: run assert_constraint_args_exist to verify constraint argument names exist in proposition results
